scope.reviewed: all 48 manifest files of chunk server, read in full; no partners
scope.removed_why: nothing removed — the manifest carries no docs/README/txt/LICENSE files; templates and CSS stayed in scope

walk.answer: No token value reaches env dump, log or response: only BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE (a path) is passed; Detail shows pid + log path only.

POST /welcome/bootstrap sits behind sameOriginGuard (cross-site forgery rejected; DNS-rebinding gap is the known server.go:338 row). since is date-parsed; extra-prompt reaches only an env var, never a shell string in this file. Log at os.TempDir() 0644: supported platforms are macOS (per-user TMPDIR) and Windows (per-user %TEMP%) — no Linux code path in internal/server, internal/shell, cmd/bootstrap — so no other local user can read or pre-plant it; location itself is the known bootstrap.go:71 row.
Token stays a file path read by bash; view carries TokenName (label) only; tailLines(output) shows claude CLI output, not the env; log line carries the sync error only.

audience/language closed-set validated before Sprintf into frontmatter (no frontmatter injection); style content capped at 64 KiB; ROUTINE_TOKEN label from plist env is constrained by handleRoutineParams to existing labels; all POSTs behind sameOriginGuard. No quantifiable exploit.
Writes go to fixed server-derived paths (profile/style under ~/.claude/context/global); the seed template path is a fixed repo-relative constant; no request-controlled path.

New routes (profile, bootstrap, sessions archive/delete) all wrapped by sameOriginGuard; the rebinding gap on them is the known server.go:338 row; archive-route shadowing is the known server.go:319 row.
Reload-failure log carries the store error only.

Archive/unarchive/delete take a single mux path segment and hand it to the sessions store; ServeMux cleans dot-segments before dispatch. Name validation lives in internal/sessions (other chunk) — flagged in notes.
Timing log lines carry repo name and durations only.

git init runs via shell.Run argv (no shell string) in a user-chosen dir; casual forced additionalDirectories grant acts on the operator's own posted path, same authority as the developer checkbox; CSRF-guarded. No privilege crossing.
Output names src/dst paths and a diff of settings the operator owns; no new secret surface.
Marker expansion is applied to fragment->live only; target closed-set; paths server-configured. install.env lookup lives in internal/config (other chunk) — noted.

routineSession is display-only prefix matching over peek cwds; no request input.
Changed lines only compute date defaults.

Read-only fragment load for drift display; no new input path.
Read-only fragment load for diff display.
Read-only fragment load for row marking; grant logic unchanged.
translate returns plain string, so every use stays auto-escaped by html/template; format-string catalog entries keep the English verb set (%d/%s/%+d), arguments are server ints/dates.
Translation and reloadSessions only; hrefs built from on-disk scope names render escaped.
New permissions kind only admits a vote record (kind closed-set, id must match a loaded status-bearing proposal); applying it is smine-apply (other chunk; known auto-apply row).

notes: Clean lane: no quantifiable exploit in chunk server beyond known rows (DNS rebinding server.go:338, bootstrap log location bootstrap.go:71, auto-apply permission widening in smine-apply). Cross-chunk items for the station, not verified here: (1) cmd/bootstrap/run.sh consumes BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT — bootstrapEnv strips only quotes and newlines, so $, backtick and backslash pass; safe only if run.sh never interpolates the value into a shell-evaluated string (input is the local operator's own form, so even then self-injection only). (2) internal/sessions ArchiveScope/UnarchiveScope/DeleteScope must reject '.', '..' and separator names — the server passes the raw path segment. (3) internal/config ExpandInstallMarkers reads install.env relative to the server cwd.
